title: A novel diagnostic four-gene signature for hepatocellular carcinoma based on artificial neural network: Development, validation, and drug screening
summary: A four-gene artificial-neural-network signature (MT1M, SPINK1, AKR1B10 and SLCO1B3) distinguished hepatocellular carcinoma in training and testing datasets, with ROC AUCs of 0.910 and 0.953. qRT-PCR and cell-viability assays provided additional checks; the diagnostic result remains based on retrospective datasets. The result remains bounded to the reported datasets and assays.
organization: Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine; Shanghai General Hospital

evidence.unknown: The source-checked evidence does not establish broader external validity or prospective benefit. Affiliation was not available in the retrieved trusted primary metadata.
evidence.ai_role: An artificial neural network classified hepatocellular carcinoma from a four-gene signature selected from expression datasets.
